categories.name: Network and server words
categories.definition: The words that push the model to IT Support are network, server, connection or hardware words. The ticket is really about a product, an app or a device fault.
categories.likely_performance_impact: 10 of 30 inspected errors. 3 are confident errors (gap above 0.15).
categories.addressable_reason: Stronger regularization or different word weighting could reduce how much one word like 'network' decides. The risk is high. These words are real IT Support signals, and 107 IT Support tickets already go to Technical Support. I did not test this on real IT Support tickets.

categories.name: Generic words
categories.definition: The push to IT Support comes from common words like 'tools', 'problems', 'current', 'it' or 'marketing'. Nothing technical in the ticket separates the two departments.
categories.likely_performance_impact: 12 of 30 inspected errors (40%). 6 are near ties (gap under 0.05), so small changes can flip them.
categories.addressable_reason: Common words carry a push to IT Support. Removing very common words (stop words or a lower max_df) or using stronger regularization reduces it. Risk: lowercasing makes the pronoun 'it' look like the acronym 'IT', so removing 'it' can remove a real IT Support signal.

categories.name: Very short ticket
categories.definition: The ticket is one short sentence (about 100 characters or less, 21 or fewer words the model knows). A few words decide the result.
categories.likely_performance_impact: 3 of 30 inspected errors (10%). 2 are confident errors from very few words.
categories.addressable_reason: The ticket has too little text. No model setting adds information. It needs a longer description or a human check.

categories.name: Label could be IT Support
categories.definition: The ticket is about access, security or a request for advice, not a fault. IT Support is a reasonable department, so the true label is debatable.
categories.likely_performance_impact: 5 of 30 inspected errors (17%). Some of these may be label problems, not model errors.
categories.addressable_reason: The text supports the model's choice. Forcing these back to Technical Support would fit unclear labels and could hurt IT Support recall.

task2_candidate.single_change: Remove very common words from the text features (stop words or a lower max_df) and retrain on the training split.
task2_candidate.expected_improvement: Some of the 12 tickets, mainly the 6 near ties, should move to Technical Support.
task2_candidate.possible_regression: IT Support could lose recall if 'it' or other useful common words are removed. Check the 107 IT Support tickets already sent to Technical Support.
